neighbours.label: the word that points to where something is or leads: 'location (of)', 'to' after lead/guide/introduce, 'direction of'
fire: After hours of questioning, the smuggler disclosed the location of the hidden cargo.
The scouts guided the lost hikers to the ranger station.
A local fisherman showed us the way to the secret cove.
The map marks the exact location where the treasure was buried.
My cousin introduced our family to a wonderful dentist.
Tracking collars led the researchers to the wolves' den.
The sailors steered the boat in the direction of the lighthouse.
Investigators finally traced the stolen money to an offshore account.
quiet: After hours of questioning, the smuggler admitted the value of the hidden cargo.
The scouts gave the lost hikers water and blankets.
A local fisherman told us stories about the old cove.
The map shows the old roads that the settlers once used.
